title: Dadi's 70th near Seven Hills or Prospect? A cake every elder can eat
summary:
Dadi's 70th. Three generations at the table, and at least one elder who has never eaten egg in her life. Seven Hills and Prospect families, this is the cake she does not have to ask about.

Every cake at Num Nums Harris Park is 100% eggless. Not the sponge, not the buttercream, not one of the 15 flavours. Which is why the vegetarian relatives can take a slice without asking what is in it. The only thing she has to check is the number of candles.

Feeding the whole extended family? An 8-inch serves 12–14 from $49.99. A 12-inch serves 25–30 from $89.99. Bring an old family photo and we can put it on the cake.

Order with 2 days' notice. Pickup from Wigram Street, Harris Park, open 11am to 10pm daily. 🎂
